title: Remote access entry (network range)
description: Expose this machine's DSH web GUI to a chosen network range (Tailscale 100.64.0.0/10 by default): only addresses inside the range are bound and peers outside it are refused, so you can reach it from a phone either with a tokenized URL or with a numeric access code. Remote pages can also use a phone layout; Enter inserts a newline and only the send button sends; and big static assets (wallpapers and the like) are cached on the phone — where the upstream sends no cache headers this plugin supplies freshness plus a weak validator, so repeat visits stop re-transferring them (no response body is ever stored on the host). The official UI preferences (appearance, font size, work details, coding view, performance & usage) can be stored in this plugin's config and applied to remote pages only. The companion Android app keeps watching in the background: it raises a status-bar notification when the model asks a question while the desktop DSH window is hidden, and now also when a turn finishes — normally or with a classified failure (malformed model output, out of balance/quota, network down, rate limited, …).
